I've asked Meadow Solutions to resend the update as plain text, and to say whether the problem is fixed and whether any quote is needed. I've also put the ticket on hold with a 2-day follow-up. result.situation: This is a tenant report of a toilet cistern that keeps filling and never stops. The landlord approved it on 18/07 (approval 20, no amount given). Meadow Solutions was assigned and the visit was booked for 26/07/2024, 2–5pm. On 27/07 an email came in from the provider, but its text can't be read (events 015/016). The records don't show the visit outcome, whether the problem is fixed, or any quote or invoice.
